terbaru.judul: An EVM-Cosmos Bridge for Atomic, Semantic-Preserving Transfer of Environmental Tokens
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a bridge that addresses both.

terbaru.judul: UniPCH: A Unified Framework for Cross-Chain Payments via Payment Channel Hubs
terbaru.pelajaran: We present UniPCH, a framework with two layers that separates native channel execution from private cross-chain payment logic.

terbaru.judul: Whether Is Not When: Separating Occurrence from Timing in Polymarket Prices
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we study this question from two aspects, using all 1.24 billion on-chain trades in 2.37 million Polymarket markets through September 2026.

terbaru.judul: Merkle-Tree-Based Verifiable Public Data Auditing for Cloud Object Storage Using Smart Contracts
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a public auditing system in which the SHA-256 hash of each object and its name forms a leaf of a Merkle tree, so the whole dataset is represented by one Merkle root.

terbaru.judul: Decentralized Medical Data Sharing with Off-chain Storage and View-based Access Control
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose the VASCO (View-based AccesS COntrol) system that does not rely on any central server including a key generation one, not rely on any special cloud storage including IPFS, not use a secure channel, encrypts both data and metadata, and supports end-to-end encryption.

terbaru.judul: ChainSEED: A Scalable, High-Fidelity Blockchain Emulator
terbaru.pelajaran: We present ChainSEED, a scalable, high-fidelity blockchain emulator built on the SEED Internet Emulator.

terbaru.judul: Peer-Relative Trust-Guided Update Screening for Robust Semi-Decentralized Federated Learning under Label-Flipping Attacks
terbaru.pelajaran: Extending an earlier trust-based semi-decentralized FL (SDFL) framework, this paper operationalizes the trust signals and introduces peer-relative update screening that combines a robust validation-utility score with direction- and norm-based update quality.

terbaru.judul: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce ABF-Bench, an interactive benchmark that makes evidence-backed fund tracing a verifiable agent task, in which every claimed movement must cite ledger records the agent retrieved.

terbaru.judul: On the (In)stability of Adaptive Fee Mechanisms in Multi-Chain Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: To fill this gap, we propose a control-theoretic framework that formalizes multi-chain fee markets as a nonlinear dynamical system with delayed feedback.

terbaru.judul: FLAI Protocol: Decentralized Federated Learning with On-Chain Rewards and sPEG-Based Contribution Scoring
terbaru.pelajaran: We present the FLAI Protocol, a trusted execution environment (TEE)-backed DeFL framework that integrates enclave-validated aggregation, sparse Peer Evaluation Graph (sPEG) scoring, and on-chain settlement.
